WorkItem.Description:
When a new project is created, the project creation wizard references the templates (e.g., Class1.ssc, AssemblyInfo.ssc) instead of copying them to the new project directory. The same happens if new classes are added.

This works correctly under Visual Studio 2008, but not under Visual Studio 2010.

(originally reported by robimalik)

This has been fixed in change set 45c103fb3936.
WorkItem.Summary: Project creation wizard does not copy the templates (Visual Studio 2010)
